site_name: Gravity Enterprise Zone / former Royal Ordnance Factory
evidence_slice: Somerset Council states that the Gravity Local Development Order for the Gravity Enterprise Zone near Puriton was formally adopted on 23 February 2022. The adopted order provides a streamlined planning route for substantial commercial floorspace and supporting uses, including up to 750 dwellings, within the LDO boundary. Somerset Council's major developments page identifies Gravity as a 616-acre Enterprise Zone, and its compliance-applications page lists approved/submitted LDO compliance applications under the adopted order. The council's official project material identifies the Gravity LDO planning reference as 95/21/00001.

field_evidence.location: Gravity Enterprise Zone near Puriton, off Junction 23 of the M5, former Royal Ordnance Factory
field_evidence.commercial_floorspace_parameter: up to 1.1 million square metres for advanced manufacturing facility and smart campus
field_evidence.permission_mechanism: adopted Local Development Order grants planning permission subject to LDO parameters/conditions and compliance approval
field_evidence.delivery_evidence: Somerset Council publishes LDO compliance applications for works and buildings under the adopted order
